correctness.rationale: PASS: The definition as inversion graphs of every permutation in S_n is exhaustive; exact graph isomorphism groups presentation duplicates, and simultaneous un-hashed 1-WL refinement for 2n rounds computes C^2 equivalence on each fixed n-vertex class. I read RESULT.md and verify_permutation.py at the assigned Git tree, including global per-round key interning and exact NetworkX isomorphism. Separately enumerated every one of the n! presentations for all n<=8 and independently recovered (p_n,q_n)=(1,1),(2,2),(4,4),(11,11),(33,33),(142,140),(776,770),(5699,5654), including exactly two six-vertex doubletons, six seven-vertex doubletons, and 38 doubles, two triples and one quadruple at eight vertices. This is a complete bounded proof, NOT a theorem about n>8. Two-n rounds suffice for stabilization across a pair via a disjoint union of at most 2n vertices.
